#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Read current version from version.json
major=$(jq '.major' version.json)
minor=$(jq '.minor' version.json)
patch=$(jq '.patch' version.json)

# Bump patch
patch=$((patch + 1))

# Write back updated version.json
jq --argjson major "$major" --argjson minor "$minor" --argjson patch "$patch" \
  '{major:$major, minor:$minor, patch:$patch}' version.json > version.json.tmp && mv version.json.tmp version.json

# Write tag.txt with new version
echo "v${major}.${minor}.${patch}" > tag.txt
